messages:
Julia H (CS): Heads-up — Renewal for ArborSky (acct: ARB-241) due next week. They're asking to apply the 3 training credits we promised during onboarding and fast-track the signature.
Omar R (RevOps): On training credits — do we have an allocation left? I thought they used 1 during Q1 enablement.
Finance Ops (bot): Invoice #INV-2026-089 drafted. Amount: $45,000. Terms currently NET30.
Liam S (AE): @Julia H customer requests NET45 due to procurement policy. Also they'll need PO before signing.
Julia H (CS): Got it. Can we apply the 2 remaining training credits as a $6k credit line on the invoice? They need the line item for budget approval.
Sarah L (Legal): We can add a line item for "enablement credit" — need internal approval for the credit amount. @Omar R can you confirm authorization level?
Omar R (RevOps): I can approve up to $10k. Go ahead. Will update the billing allocation code to TRAINING-CREDIT.
Liam S (AE): Procurement wants the PO to reference SOW v2. I'll attach the SOW link: https://redwood.internal/docs/sow/arborsky-v2
Julia H (CS): Also, they're asking to have Docusign routed to their legal contact first (maria.gomez@arborsky.com) then CFO. Any preference on signature order?
Sarah L (Legal): Sequential signing OK. Add clause for "no automatic renew without signed amendment" per their counsel.
Julia H (CS): I'll prepare the Docusign routing and include the training credit line. Draft below:
```
Line Items:
- Redwood Inference annual subscription: $51,000
- Training credit (2 sessions) applied: -$6,000
Net Due: $45,000
Terms: NET45 (per PO)
SOW: arborsky-v2
```
Liam S (AE): Perfect. @DocuSign Bot please create envelope when docs are ready and route to maria.gomez first.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope created: envelope_id=env_8f4b2. Routing: maria.gomez -> carlos.martinez (CFO). Status: pending signature.
Julia H (CS): Quick note — customer asked for a post-signing enablement workshop scheduled within 2 weeks. Can EMs confirm availability?
Omar R (RevOps): I'll block tentative slots: May 8 & May 15. Confirm once signed.
Finance Ops (bot): PO received: PO-88921, amount matches; will release after signed envelope confirmed.
Liam S (AE): Thanks team. I'll keep CS & RevOps looped. If signature stalls, escalate to CRO.
Julia H (CS): Closing loop — action items: 1) Omar apply credit and approve billing code; 2) Sarah confirm legal clause; 3) Liam confirm PO & attach SOW; 4) Julia finalize envelope and schedule enablement. Back to you all.
Sarah L (Legal): Clause approved.
Omar R (RevOps): Credit applied.
DocuSign Bot: maria.gomez signed at 1768890032. Awaiting carlos.martinez.
Liam S (AE): PO matched. CFO out until Friday — will ping for final sign on Monday.
Julia H (CS): Thanks — marking thread resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
